verdict.rationale: Microsoft's Copilot privacy FAQ says users can opt out of having their conversation activity used for model training at any time, and it names model training as a use of that data. Community comments voice uncertainty about whether documents in integrated Office apps feed training and suggest some controls apply only to standalone Copilot, but neither concretely contradicts the opt-out. Missing for 10: documentation of where and how the opt-out setting works, clear scope across Microsoft 365 app integrations, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the opt-out is honored.
